serviceOutput: Personal Knowledge Graph Architecture: Connecting concepts, authors, projects, and citations across reading corpora.
Token-Saving Subgraph Extraction: Slashing prompt tokens by 60% to 80% by replacing raw text dumps with targeted triples.
Hybrid Graph-RAG Query Engine: Uncovering non-obvious multi-hop connections with Leiden community detection.
Canonical Entity Resolution: Merging aliases deterministically to prevent graph fragmentation and hallucinated edges.
Local-First Graph Storage: Zero-egress deployment with SQLite, NetworkX, and KuzuDB.
